summary: Put this reader on your tailnet, with an on/off switch and the approval code on screen.
page_description: EXPERIMENTAL: reach tailnet services - Calibre-Web, paperterm hosts, anything with a 100.x address - from any network. Not yet validated on hardware.
release_notes: First experimental cut: runtime-owned tailscaled, kernel TUN with netfilter off, /etc/hosts tailnet names, on-screen approval code.

steps.text: The first time Tailscale runs it downloads the pinned upstream ARMv7 build over Wi-Fi and checks it against the digest the runtime requires, so the Kobo needs to be online once.
Turn Tailscale on. Within a minute the screen shows a short approval code; open the link on any phone or computer and approve this reader.
In the Tailscale admin console, disable key expiry for this device - node keys expire after 180 days by default and the connection would silently stop.
